# Kesari Foods: facts

- Kesari Foods sells Alphonso mangoes from partner farms in Devgad, Maharashtra.
- A box of 12 mangoes costs Rs 1,499 with delivery included.
- Mangoes are picked and shipped within 48 hours.
- Boxes reach customers across India in 3 to 5 days.
- 4,200 families ordered from us last season.
- Customers rate us 4.7 out of 5 from 860 reviews.
- Every mango ripens naturally. We never use carbide.
- If more than 2 mangoes in a box arrive spoiled, we send a free replacement.
- The season runs from April to June.
- You can pay by UPI, card or cash on delivery.
- Mango pulp comes in 500 g tins at Rs 349.
- Meera Kesari started the company in Pune.
- Our support team answers on WhatsApp from 9 am to 8 pm.
- Each box is packed by hand and padded with rice straw.
